headline: Fed’s Waller Favors Holding Rates in September — Unless August Inflation Runs Hot
summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said he is inclined to hold rates in September, but warned a hot August inflation print could push him to back a hike.

headline: August Jobs Report Preview: What Would Make a Fed Hike a Done Deal?
summary: Fed futures are split 50-50 ahead of Friday's August jobs report. Here's what the payrolls print needs to make a September hike a done deal.
